title: Lifted output oracle answers
statement: Let $f$ be a function on bit strings, let $m$ be a Boolean mode, let $x$ and $b$ be bit strings, and let $p,i$ be natural numbers. The lifted oracle, queried at the encoding formed by nesting the pairs $(x,b)$, then its binary index $p$, then the binary index $i$, returns true exactly when $i<|f(x)|$ if $m$ is true; if $m$ is false, it returns the bit of $f(x)$ at position $i$, with out-of-range positions interpreted as false.
